content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Orlando

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires specific education and project-management experience before you apply. Review PMI's documented prerequisites—typically a combination of formal education and verifiable hours leading projects or teams. Granite PM Academy's advisors can help you assess whether your background meets PMI's standards for this credential.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP preparation course. This formal education satisfies PMI's mandatory contact-hour requirement and covers the full PMBOK framework, domains, and real-world scenarios. Our instructors—active certified practitioners—deliver the content online so you can complete the course on your schedule from anywhere.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Once you finish the course, apply directly to PMI through their official portal. You'll report your education, experience, and contact-hour completion from Granite PM Academy. Pay PMI's exam fee at application time. Granite PM Academy provides step-by-step guidance to ensure your submission is accurate and complete.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—including practice questions, study guides, and instructor support—to reinforce your knowledge. Schedule your proctored exam through PMI's testing partner. On exam day, you'll demonstrate mastery of project-management domains and earn the PMP credential upon passing.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: The PMP requires renewal every three years by earning Professional Development Units (PDUs). Granite PM Academy offers PDU-eligible courses and resources to help you stay current with PMI standards. Ongoing education keeps your credential active and your skills aligned with industry best practices.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
